patterns.note: The site uses a full-bleed hero video that spans the entire viewport width, with content overlaid directly on top of it.
Content sections are clearly delineated by alternating full-width background colors, creating distinct visual blocks as the user scrolls.
A vibrant and high-contrast primary color palette is used, featuring lime green, bright yellow, deep red, and a striking purple for calls to action, creating an energetic and playful feel.
The hero video background subtly scales and parallaxes as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic and immersive initial experience.
Content sections are revealed with a subtle slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling, guiding the user's eye down the page.
A persistent cookie consent banner is fixed to the bottom of the viewport, remaining visible across all scroll depths.
All text uses a clean, modern sans-serif typeface, with clear hierarchy established through significant size and weight variations for headings versus body text and uppercase for navigation.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed video background that subtly scales and parallaxes as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic backdrop for the overlaid introductory content.
Content sections are designed to reveal themselves by sliding upwards into the viewport as the user scrolls down the page, creating a sense of progression.
The main navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport, ensuring constant access to site links without any visual transformation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are significantly larger and bolder than body text, with navigation and labels using a smaller, uppercase variant of the body font.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and input fields, maintaining a clean, modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing overall, with the hero and some content sections featuring more airy vertical separation to emphasize key messages.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold and vibrant color palette, which uses high-contrast primary colors like lime green, bright yellow, and deep red, paired with a striking purple for calls to action. This energetic color scheme, combined with the intimate, close-up human face in the hero video, creates a uniquely warm and playful brand identity that stands apart from typical minimalist or clinical beauty sites.
